description: This file contains utility functions for managing RFC parameters and TR-181 parameters, including getting, setting, and clearing attributes, as well as command-line argument parsing and main program logic.

methods.name: getParamType
methods.description: Retrieves the parameter type for a given parameter name using RFC API.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts a character representing a data type ('s', 'i', 'b') to a DATA_TYPE enum.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter or TR-181 local parameter and writes it to output.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets the value of a parameter or local parameter based on provided type and value.

methods.name: clearAttribute
methods.description: Clears a parameter or local parameter.

methods.name: showusage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the command-line utility.

methods.name: parseargs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine operation mode and parameters.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the utility, handling argument parsing, operation execution, and output redirection.
